text:
Priya: heads-up: sales asked for a small playbook and numbers to support a faster SLA for inbound leads during product launch week. primary ask: ensure claims <= 60s and owner ack <= 2m for 95% of traffic during surge.
Liam: ok. are we changing RR logic or just scaling owners/overflow?
Priya: want both options exercised. two arms: 1) RR with jitter+decay (so owners don't get consecutive hot streaks), 2) overflow pool + sticky reassign after ack timeout. compare metrics.
Noah: i'll model surge at 4x baseline for 30m windows. enrichment latency distributions: nominal 200ms, slow tail to 3s. also simulate an enrichment TTL miss to trigger fallback assign.
Sandra: for HubSpot <> SF mapping, we need to test owner_id mismatches and external_owner_id fallthrough. will stub HS webhook to sometimes drop owner field.
Liam: propose acceptance criteria: claim_time_p95 <= 60s, ack_time_p95 <= 120s, default-owner-fallthrough_rate <= 0.5% when enrichment healthy. if enrichment degrades, fallback threshold can rise to 2.5%.
Priya: sounds reasonable. include an ops-runbook note with steps to increase overflow pool and disable RR jitter if we see increased default fallthrough.
Noah: quick config for RR jitter/decay i
```yaml
round_robin:
  jitter_ms: 300
  consecutive_limit: 2
  decay_window_s: 120
overflow:
  enabled: true
  pool_size: 6
  ack_timeout_s: 120
  fallback_owner: "default-sales"
```
Liam: add heartbeat debounce to avoid double-claim; heartbeat settings: 15s probe, 45s stale cutoff. that should reduce owner thrash when people are offline.
Priya: also capture metrics: claim_attempts_per_lead, claim_success, claim_latency_ms, owner_ack_latency_ms, fallback_reason (enrichment_timeout, missing_owner, owner_unavailable).
Sandra: i'll enqueue a small canary deployment for NA and EMEA with 1h ramp and manual cutover. label runs: launch-week-armA (jitter) and launch-week-armB (overflow).
leadops-bot: Simulation scheduled: 2025-07-05T03:00Z. Artifacts will be posted to /sim-results/leadflow-surge/1759876543.
Noah: ETA for first graphs ~4h after run. i'll export heatmap csv and a short summary note.
Priya: thanks. once we have numbers, we'll fold into the launch playbook and a one-pager for sales ops with the rollback steps. please @-me when summaries are posted. :rocket:
